subject: AcmeCorp Private/VPC - Post-call recap & next steps
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: AcmeCorp Private/VPC - Post-call recap & next steps

Hi Alex --

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we're aligned:

What we heard (pain points / drivers)
- Primary requirement: on-prem / private VPC deployment due to PHI and data residency (US-only).
- Environment is heavily restricted: egress to public internet is blocked for inference hosts.
- You need an air-gapped or limited-egress option with the ability to push updates via controlled channels.
- Key security must-haves: integration with your KMS/HSM, SOC 2 evidence, and audit logs for model access.
- Ops constraint: limited network engineering bandwidth; any VPN/peering work needs clear runbook and minimal config.

Goals / success criteria
- POC of Redwood Private (VPC or on-prem) within ~6 weeks.
- Throughput target: ~50 concurrent requests with 200ms median latency for typical prompt sizes.
- Data never leaves customer VPC; logs and telemetry sent to your SIEM only after redaction.

Open questions / risks
- Exactly how restrictive is the egress policy (full block vs. allowlist to specific Redwood endpoints)?
- Do you require an air-gap (no outbound traffic at all) or only restricted egress to our control plane?
- Who will own the KMS integration and cert rotation on your side (network/security contact)?

Next steps (proposed)
1) I'll share our Private deployment checklist and a short network runbook (attached). Please confirm if an air-gap is required or if allowlist/peering is acceptable.
2) Schedule a 60-minute technical deep-dive with Rishi (SE) and your infra/security team this week to review network diagram, certs, KMS, and deployment options: https://calendly.com/redwood/tech-deep-dive-30
3) You to share any existing network constraints document or diagram (you mentioned an internal spreadsheet) and the procurement contact for contracting.

Attachments: redwood-private-deploy-checklist.pdf (deployment steps + required ports), sample SOC2 evidence index.

Thanks -- looking forward to the deep-dive.

Best,
Camila Reyes

Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AcmeCorp Private/VPC - Post-call recap & next steps

Camila --

Thanks for the clear recap. Confirming a few details from our side:
- We do have a strict egress policy. For production, the goal is effectively air-gapped (no outbound traffic from inference hosts). For the POC we can allow restricted egress through a jumpbox or controlled gateway, but long-term we expect an on-prem or VPC-hosted deployment with no direct internet access.
- PHI is in scope; any solution must be able to guarantee that model inputs/outputs are not sent to external services.
- KMS: our security team prefers using our on-prem HSM for key management. We will need an integration pattern that supports this.
- Timeline: Q2 target for POC kickoff; procurement wants a rough commercial ballpark to kick off internal approvals.

I attached a short spreadsheet with our network constraints and current change window (acme-network-constraints.xlsx).

Next steps on our side: I'll loop in our security lead (Sarah Lee) and the procurement contact; Sarah can confirm HSM/KMS specifics. We're available for the tech deep-dive Wed or Thu afternoon PT.

Appreciate the checklist -- looking forward to the runbook.

--Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of Data Products, Acme Corp
alex.johnson@acmecorp.com

Subject: Re: AcmeCorp Private/VPC - Post-call recap & next steps

Alex --

Perfect, thanks for the clarity. Quick replies inline:
- Air-gap vs restricted egress: we support both patterns. For air-gap we offer an air-gapped on-prem bundle + manual update process; for restricted egress we provide a documented allowlist and a control-plane-less deployment mode where telemetry is pushed via your jumpbox. We'll walk through both with Rishi.
- HSM/KMS: noted -- Rishi will present our KMS integration patterns and a few proven approaches for HSM-backed keys.
- Commercial ballpark: I'll put together a preliminary POC estimate (tailored for a VPC/on-prem scoping) and send it to procurement this afternoon so you have something for internal approvals.

Proposed times for the tech deep-dive (PT):
- Wed 3/4 2:00-3:00pm
- Thu 3/5 1:00-2:00pm
Please confirm which works and I'll send a calendar invite with an agenda. In the meantime I uploaded the private deployment checklist and the sample runbook here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/abc123

Thanks -- Camila
